title: Black Swan Hedges Explained: Tail Risk Protection with Deep OTM Puts | Strategic Options Hedging
description:
Black Swan Hedges Explained — Deep OTM Puts, Tail-Risk Protection & Crash Convexity

In this video, we break down one of the most effective tail-risk hedges used by sophisticated traders: buying far-out-of-the-money (FOTM) put options to protect against rare but catastrophic market crashes.

Using Thinkorswim’s ThinkBack tool, we walk through what happened during the March 2020 crash, how volatility exploded, and why tiny allocations of deep OTM puts can return 30–50x during true Black Swan events.

You'll learn strike selection, expirations, sizing rules, long-Vega dynamics, and how traders hedge using SPX, SPY, and ES futures options.
